title: Command-Line Parameter Life Cycle (sys.argv)
description: Step-by-step trace of how the OS shell populates sys.argv, converts string arguments to numeric arrays, and performs list aggregation.

len(argv) is 4, which is not < 2. The argument check passes successfully, avoiding usage errors.
Each string element is converted via int() into typed integers: [10, 20, 30].
